gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.2 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -6.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -6.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Saipem Lands $350M Contract for West Hub Tails Project in Angola
top.summary: Saipem has won a $350 million subsea contract for Azule Energy's West Hub Tails project offshore Angola. The work includes engineering, fabrication, and installation of 62 km of flowlines, risers, and umbilicals tied to the Agogo FPSO. The project will extend the productive life of four mature fields by rerouting production from the aging Ngoma FPSO to the newer Agogo FPSO over approximately 2.5 years.

top.title: Short-Term Bond ETFs to Gain as Fed Hikes Interest Rates
top.summary: Following the Federal Reserve's first interest rate hike in over three years (raising rates to 3.75-4.00% in September 2026), short-term bond ETFs are positioned as attractive investment vehicles. These funds benefit from low duration risk and rapid portfolio turnover that allows yields to adjust upward as maturing debt is reinvested at higher coupon rates, offering income with minimal capital depreciation risk.

top.title: BTSG Faces $200M IRA Hit but Efficiency May Protect Profitability
top.summary: BrightSpring Health Services' Home and Community Pharmacy segment experienced an 8% revenue decline to $540M in Q2, with the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) accounting for approximately $50M of the impact. Despite a projected $200M revenue headwind in 2026 from IRA pricing changes, the company expects only a $15M EBITDA impact, demonstrating that operational efficiency gains from technology, automation, AI, and Lean initiatives are offsetting regulatory pressures. Peer companies Cardinal Health and CVS Health are similarly navigating IRA-driven revenue pressures while maintaining profitability through service agreements and operational improvements.

top.title: IQVIA Stock Rises 60% in 6 Months: Here's What You Should Know
top.summary: IQVIA (IQV) has surged 60.1% over six months, driven by 6% organic growth in Q2 2026, with R&DS bookings up 19.3% and a $34.2 billion backlog. The company's rapid AI adoption—294 agents deployed across 90 use cases with 19 of top 20 pharma companies adopting solutions—is strengthening its competitive position and supporting sustained growth.

top.title: Can CAH Navigate IRA Pricing Changes Risk Without Margin Pressure?
top.summary: Cardinal Health expects fiscal 2027 IRA pricing changes to create similar revenue headwinds as 2026, but management aims to preserve compensation and maintain profitability through distribution agreements and operational efficiency. Peers BrightSpring and CVS Health also face IRA-related revenue pressure but are offsetting impacts through operational improvements and specialty pharmacy growth.

top.title: Here's Why You Should Add BrightSpring Stock to Your Portfolio Now
top.summary: BrightSpring Health Services (BTSG) is rated a Strong Buy with strong momentum in Provider Services and expanding specialty pharmacy and infusion operations. However, the company faces near-term margin pressure from Inflation Reduction Act reimbursement cuts and execution risks from multiple integrations and geographic expansions through 2026.

top.title: TJX Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook as Q2 Results Show Broad-Based Growth
top.summary: TJX Companies raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.20 following strong Q2 results that exceeded expectations. The company reported 11% earnings growth and 4% comparable sales growth, driven by higher merchandise margins and broad divisional gains. TJX also increased its long-term global store target by 500 locations to 7,500, planning 4% annual store growth from fiscal 2028. However, Marmaxx, the company's largest division, showed slower 1% comparable-sales growth, which management attributed to merchandise-mix issues.

top.title: TJX Falls 17.4% in the Past Month as Strong Results Meet Key Risks
top.summary: TJX Companies shares declined 17.4% in a month despite beating Q2 earnings expectations and raising fiscal 2027 guidance. While most divisions showed growth, Marmaxx comparable sales rose only 1%, below expectations due to merchandise mix issues. The company faces headwinds from higher wage and fuel costs, and its valuation premium leaves limited room for error.

top.title: Should Investors Buy TJX as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?
top.summary: TJX Companies raised fiscal 2027 EPS guidance and targets 5%-6% sales growth with plans to expand stores to 7,500 locations. However, the stock trades at a premium valuation (P/S ratio of 2.06 vs. industry 1.58) that leaves little room for execution errors. Key risks include Marmaxx underperformance and rising cost pressures, though strong cash generation supports growth and shareholder returns.

top.title: TJX International's Adjusted Margin Hits 7.3%: More Upside Ahead?
top.summary: TJX Companies' International division achieved significant profitability gains in Q2 FY2027, with adjusted segment profit margin rising 210 basis points year-over-year to 7.3%. The division reported net sales of $2.09 billion, up 11% from the prior year, driven by higher customer transactions and 7% comparable sales growth. The margin improvement was supported by favorable merchandise margins and expense leverage, while the company continued expansion efforts in Europe.

top.title: Robbins LLP Reminds BZAI Investors of the Pending Class Action Lawsuit; Harmed Investors Should Contact the Firm for Information About Leading the Class Action Against Blaize Holdings, Inc.
top.summary: Robbins LLP is reminding investors of a pending class action lawsuit against Blaize Holdings, Inc. The critical infrastructure supplies 10 refineries and propane facilities across the Midwest. Environmental monitoring shows no impacts to wildlife or water sources, and the company continues remediation efforts while coordinating with authorities.

top.title: Saipem Lands $350M Contract for West Hub Tails Project in Angola
top.summary: Saipem has won a $350 million subsea contract for Azule Energy's West Hub Tails project offshore Angola. The work includes engineering, fabrication, and installation of 62 km of flowlines, risers, and umbilicals tied to the Agogo FPSO. The project will extend the productive life of four mature fields by rerouting production from the aging Ngoma FPSO to the newer Agogo FPSO over approximately 2.5 years.

top.title: Electra Advances Phased Nickel Refining and Battery Recycling Strategy for North America
top.summary: Electra Battery Materials announced preliminary engineering results for a proposed two-phase nickel refinery designed to process mine-derived feedstock and recycled battery black mass into nickel metal and battery-grade nickel sulfate. The first phase would produce approximately 20,000 tonnes per year of contained nickel with 97%+ recovery rates. Capital estimates range from US$530-675 million, with a potential second phase adding another 20,000 tonnes annually. The facility aims to strengthen North American critical minerals supply chains and reduce reliance on Chinese processing.

top.summary: Electra Battery Materials Corporation has been granted a 180-calendar-day extension until March 15, 2027, to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The company must achieve a closing bid price at or above US$1.00 for 10 consecutive business days to regain compliance. The extension does not affect current trading or operations, and the company indicated it may pursue a reverse stock split if necessary to meet the requirement.

top.title: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Market Set for Strong Growth Through 2036, Driven by Next-Generation Innovation and Expanding Patient Access

Key challenges include relapse rates, manufacturing complexity, and toxicity management, while opportunities exist in earlier treatment lines and off-the-shelf platforms.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -1.6 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -1.6 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired HDFC Bank Limited HDB Securities Between July 17, 2023 and May 26, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against HDFC Bank Limited for allegedly making materially false statements and failing to disclose that the company camouflaged payments as marketing spend to pay higher interest rates to a state firm to induce deposits. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +7.7 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +7.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Lennar Corporation reported disappointing Q3 fiscal 2026 results with adjusted EPS falling 38.5% to $1.23 and revenues declining 8.6% to $8.05B. top.title: Lennar (LEN) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
top.summary: Lennar reported $8.05 billion in revenue for Q3 2026, down 8.7% year-over-year and missing consensus estimates by 3.44%. EPS of $1.23 fell short of the $1.29 estimate. Key operational metrics also disappointed, including lower home deliveries (20,840 vs. 21,439 estimated), fewer new orders (20,879 vs. 21,300), and reduced active communities. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

top.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Lennar  and Wayfair

top.title: Autoimmune Disease Therapeutics Market Set for Growth Through 2034 as Biologics, Precision Medicine and Pipeline Innovation Reshape the Competitive Landscape

Growth is driven by rising autoimmune disease diagnoses, increased adoption of biologics and targeted oral therapies, biosimilar expansion, and emerging cell and gene therapies. Biologics dominate with 66% market share, TNF inhibitors lead drug classes at 29%, and rheumatoid arthritis accounts for 34% of revenue. North America holds 44% regional share while Asia-Pacific is expected to grow fastest.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Growth is driven by broader clinical adoption, new indications, earlier-line use, and innovation in autologous and allogeneic platforms. The U.S. dominates with $1.90 billion in 2025 market value, while diffuse large B-cell lymphoma represents the largest patient population with approximately 78,000 cases across the markets.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.7 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +5.0 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +5.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Autoimmune Disease Therapeutics Market Set for Growth Through 2034 as Biologics, Precision Medicine and Pipeline Innovation Reshape the Competitive Landscape
top.summary: The global autoimmune disease therapeutics market is projected to grow from USD 132.75 billion in 2025 to USD 254.60 billion by 2034, at a CAGR of 7.5%. Growth is driven by rising autoimmune disease diagnoses, increased adoption of biologics and targeted oral therapies, biosimilar expansion, and emerging cell and gene therapies. Biologics dominate with 66% market share, TNF inhibitors lead drug classes at 29%, and rheumatoid arthritis accounts for 34% of revenue. North America holds 44% regional share while Asia-Pacific is expected to grow fastest.

top.title: Immunotherapy Drugs Market 2026: Precision Medicine, Next-Generation Biologics and Expanding Cancer Indications Fuel Growth Opportunities
top.summary: The global immunotherapy drugs market is experiencing significant growth driven by advances in biotechnology, rising demand for targeted treatments, and expanding therapeutic applications across cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Key growth factors include increasing disease burden, robust drug pipelines, personalized medicine adoption, and combination therapy development. The Americas and Europe remain dominant markets, while Asia-Pacific is emerging as a high-growth region. Major pharmaceutical and biotech companies are increasing R&D investments and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

top.title: Oligonucleotide Therapeutics Market Outlook 2026-2035 - Featuring Profiles of Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Ionis Pharmaceuticals, and Sarepta Therapeutics
top.summary: The global oligonucleotide therapeutics market is projected to grow from USD 7.7 billion in 2025 to USD 72.1 billion by 2035, expanding at a 23.4% CAGR. Growth is driven by advances in RNA-based medicine, targeted delivery technologies, expanding applications beyond rare diseases into chronic and metabolic conditions, and increasing regulatory approvals. Antisense oligonucleotides lead the market at 39.9% share, while subcutaneous administration dominates at 56.4%. North America commands 57.9% market share.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.7 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.7 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

top.title: Experiencing New Changes in AI Applications at CIFTIS
top.summary: At the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services in Beijing, AI technology is being integrated into core business processes across multiple sectors. Companies like Feixiang Xingqiu are using AI to automate teaching material creation, Meituan is deploying AI agents for merchant operations and customer feedback analysis, and ZTO Express has deployed over 3,500 unmanned delivery vehicles across 260+ cities. Nearly 40% of showcased cases feature AI as core technology, signaling a shift from isolated applications to systematic, platform-based AI development.
